## Bug Report

> **Please Note:** This is a personal project I manage in my free time. I'm happy to take a look at bugs you find, but I can't guarantee I'll fix them or offer any kind of timeline. 
> 
> **CRITICAL EXCEPTION:** If you notice an **exposed API key, password, or personal information** anywhere in this repository, please do not open a public issue. Email me immediately at **azariahyonas22@gmail.com** so I can jump in and secure it fast. For regular code bugs, you can fill out the form below.

---

### What's happening?
Please give a quick description of the bug and what went wrong.

### How can I reproduce it?
Let me know the steps you took so I can try to recreate the issue on my end:
1. Go to...
2. Click on...
3. See error...

### What should have happened instead?
What did you expect the code or page to do?

### Visuals (Screenshots or GIFs)
If you can, please drop a screenshot or a quick recording of the issue here—it helps a lot.

### Your Environment (If relevant)
If you think it matters (like a layout breaking on a specific browser or screen size), let me know what you are using.

### Anything else?
Any extra context, error logs, or details you want to add.
